text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to the cafeteria with Twin 
Turbo to grab some lunch, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Rice-chan, you ate all of this!? 
Th-That's gotta be like thirty servings... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! I was just so hungry. If I 
caused trouble for everyone—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
No, no! I just think it's amazing! How 
much you eat is important for running, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you think so too, right, Turbo? She 
has a similar build to us, but she's so 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmmghhh... Turbo's amazing too, so I 
should be able to eat a ton, too!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Rice, let's race~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehhー!! Why why why!!
choice_data_list: Everyone knows how amazing Twin Turbo is

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! Rice thinks so too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo is always so positive... She 
makes everyone smile, and that's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for saying something so weird. I 
know lots of amazing things about you too, 
Turbo.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~~. As long as you understand, it's 
all good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, satisfied at last, Twin Turbo 
broke into a wide smile.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's gonna go get the food! Wait right 
there, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, an eating contest with Rice Shower 
unilaterally began—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R... Rice is... already... so full...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I did…… it……! Turbo…… won……!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Turbo, that's amazing! Beating Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... *urp*...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite struggling, Twin Turbo scarfed it 
all down and pulled off a narrow yet 
glorious victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll keep it to myself that Rice 
Shower ate quite a massive amount before 
the showdown."
